scope: New projectCommercial rules and anti-reinsertion guards only; not a whole-system audit
summary: Scoped review and emulator checks cover authenticated roles, document versus list access, authority from stored ACL, parent existence, field allowlists, required version/timestamp, size/type/range bounds, malformed values, and public-root reinsertion. No unresolved finding within this narrow scope.
limitations: Operational project name/code and expense data remain shared under existing project permissions.
Backend IAM operators and trusted integrations are outside client-rule isolation.
Data downloaded before migration cannot be revoked retroactively.
